bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to state government; requiring technical assistance and legal services to the prescription drug affordability advisory council; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 62J.88, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 62J.88, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 7.

Technical assistance; legal services.

(a) The commissioner of commerce must provide technical assistance to the advisory council.

(b) The attorney general must provide legal services to the advisory council.
additions: (a) The commissioner of commerce must provide technical assistance to the advisory council.
(b) The attorney general must provide legal services to the advisory council.
